action.text: Leave a short voicemail in the person's language: say you are the ${LINE_NAME} with an urgent safety message for {{zone_name}}, read this approved alert word for word: "{{alert_message}} {{alert_action}}", then say they can verify on {{alert_source}} or call 2-1-1, and call this number back if they need help. If drill mode is "true", start by saying it is a drill. Under 30 seconds.

post_call_analysis_data.name: alert_heard
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the person heard the full alert live (not voicemail).

post_call_analysis_data.name: safe_status
post_call_analysis_data.description: Did the person say they are safe and able to follow the action?

post_call_analysis_data.name: needs
post_call_analysis_data.description: Needs the person mentioned (wheelchair, oxygen, no car, pets, other), or empty.

post_call_analysis_data.name: needs_followup
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if a person on our team should follow up.

post_call_analysis_data.name: opted_out
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if they asked to stop alert calls.
